## Description

Closes #(issue number), if applicable.

## Area
- [ ] Frontend (`frontend/`)
- [ ] Backend (`backend/`)

## Type of change

## How has this been tested?
Describe how you ran it (`npm run dev` / `npm run preview`) and which pages you checked (home, gallery modal, events, enquiry form, navigation, mobile layout).

## Checklist

- [ ] Every affected page renders correctly under `/euphoric/` and the hash routes work

- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed
- [ ] I have updated documentation where needed
